This is an on-demand/project-based position. As an On-Demand/Project-Based UX Researcher, you will have the opportunity to work on a diverse array of projects with various clients, contributing your expertise to uncover valuable user insights. You will conduct comprehensive user research using a range of methodologies, providing actionable recommendations that shape the design and development of our clients. 

Responsibilities

Conduct User Research: 

• Assist in planning and conducting user research activities such as user interviews, usability testing, surveys, and focus groups, tailored to each project's objectives. 

• Aid in recruiting participants for research studies and coordinating research sessions. 

Data Collection and Analysis: 

• Assist in collecting qualitative and quantitative data, ensuring accuracy and completeness. 

• Help with organizing and synthesizing research findings, contributing to the analysis process. 

Report and Documentation: 

• Assist in documenting research methodologies, findings, and insights. 

• Contribute to the creation of clear and concise research reports and presentations. 

• Prepare research reports, presentations, and other deliverables for internal and external stakeholders. 

Collaboration: 

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including UX designers, developers, product managers, and clients, to integrate research findings into the design and development process. 

• Participate in meetings, workshops, and brainstorming sessions to contribute insights and ideas. 

Adaptability: 

• Be adaptable and responsive to meet the evolving research needs and priorities of our agency, especially in an on-demand, project-based environment. 

• Be flexible with your time and availability to align with our agency's requirements and deadlines. 

Communication: 

• Let us know your availability for work periodically with our managers to better 

• Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, providing updates on research progress and findings. 

• Present research findings and recommendations clearly and persuasively, both orally and in writing. 

Support The Research Team: 

• Assist our UX Research team in our projects by helping with research tasks and providing support as needed. 

• Learn from experienced researchers and seek guidance to enhance your research skills and expertise. 

Qualifications

Must have: 

• Strong passion for user research and UX design. 

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. 

• Have a base theoretical knowledge of: Usability Testing, User Interview, Expert Review, Personas, and User Journey. 

Preferable: 

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. 

• Knowledgable of the key UX research tools and software, such as usability testing software, survey platforms, and analytics tools. 

• Excellent communication and presentation skills. 

Nice to have: 

• Acquired or successfully passed Related UX Courses, Certificates. 

• Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Anthropology, or a similar discipline) or an equivalent years or expertise in the field.

Senior Product Designer – Design Systems & AI
Full-time | Riyadh

We are partnering with a growing technology organisation to appoint a Senior Product Designer to shape the design of AI-powered products across web and mobile.

This is a hands-on role combining product design, interaction design, visual design and design-system development. You will design products that are actively shipping while building the reusable foundations that allow engineering teams to deliver consistent experiences across multiple products.

The role is suited to a designer with strong product craft and proven experience building production design systems. You will work closely with engineering to turn design decisions into reusable components, tokens, documentation and implementation-ready assets.

Key Responsibilities
Design user flows, screens, interactions and product states across web and mobile.
Establish a consistent visual language across typography, colour, spacing, layout, iconography and motion.
Build and maintain a scalable design system covering tokens, components, patterns and usage guidelines.
Create design libraries and assets that engineering teams can use directly.
Translate design decisions into implementation-ready specifications and documentation.
Design AI-specific experiences including conversational interfaces, generated content, system activity, errors and human approval workflows.
Work with engineers to review implementation and improve the system based on real product usage.
Use AI tooling to accelerate design, prototyping and development handoff.
Manage system evolution through documentation, versioning and removal of outdated patterns.

What We're Looking For
8+ years of experience in product, UX/UI or digital product design.
Strong portfolio of shipped products across web and mobile.
Excellent visual and interaction design skills with strong attention to detail.
Proven experience building and maintaining production design systems.
Advanced Figma experience, including components, variables, auto layout and shared libraries.
Experience translating design systems into assets that engineering teams can implement directly.
Strong understanding of responsive and cross-platform product design.
Experience using AI tools within design and product workflows.
Experience designing AI-powered, conversational or agent-based products is highly desirable.
Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineering teams through collaboration rather than authority.
AI Product Design

Relevant experience may include:
Conversational and chat interfaces.
Dynamic or generated content.
Automated workflows and agent interactions.
Loading, latency, error and refusal states.
Citations, references or supporting information.
Human review and approval experiences.

Technical Environment
Figma | Design Systems | Design Tokens | Component Libraries | CSS | React | Mobile | Prototyping | AI Design Tools | Generative AI

Nice to Have
Accessibility and WCAG experience.
RTL and bilingual product experience, particularly Arabic and English.
Front-end development experience.
Experience with design-to-development tooling.
Motion and interaction design.
Data-heavy or operational interfaces.
Usability testing or user research.
Experience supporting multiple product teams through one shared design system.

data.description_text:
About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Intelligence platform that helps organizations understand customer conversations, uncover actionable insights, and improve customer experiences through advanced AI capabilities.

As the platform continues to grow, maintaining reliable, secure, and high-performing data infrastructure is critical to supporting our customers and enabling continuous product innovation.

Our database environment spans multiple cloud platforms and hosting environments, supporting business-critical workloads, high-volume data ingestion, and multi-tenant applications. We are looking for a Database Administrator who can help strengthen our database operations, improve resilience, and ensure our data infrastructure remains reliable as we scale.

Why this role matters

Our database infrastructure is growing in both scale and complexity. With production PostgreSQL and MySQL environments running across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and our in-Kingdom hosting environment, maintaining database availability, performance, and recoverability is essential to the reliability of our platform.

As a Database Administrator, you'll take ownership of the health and operational reliability of our production databases. You'll work on challenges that go beyond routine administration, including multi-terabyte database environments, high-availability architecture, disaster recovery, major-version upgrades, and safe database migrations.

You'll also work closely with engineering, cloud, and reliability teams to help developers make better database decisions, prevent production incidents, and improve the way database changes are designed and delivered.

If you enjoy solving complex database performance challenges, building resilient data infrastructure, and taking ownership of critical production systems, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

What You'll Do

Manage and maintain PostgreSQL and MySQL databases across AWS, GCP, and self-managed environments
Monitor database performance, availability, and capacity
Optimize queries, indexing, and database resource utilization
Manage backups, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery
Implement database replication, high availability, and failover strategies
Plan database upgrades, migrations, and safe schema changes
Maintain database security, access controls, and auditing
Automate database operations using Bash, Python, or similar tools
Troubleshoot database incidents and perform root-cause analysis
Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, SRE, and Cloud teams to improve database reliability and scalability

What success looks like (First 90-120 Days)

First 30 days:

You've developed a clear understanding of the production database estate across AWS, GCP, and SITE
You understand the existing database architecture, operational workflows, monitoring, and recovery procedures
You've built strong working relationships with the database team, Cloud Engineering, SRE, and development teams
You've identified the most significant risks and improvement opportunities across availability, performance, backup, and recovery

By day 60:

You're independently handling assigned database administration and troubleshooting activities
You've reviewed backup configurations and started validating recovery procedures for critical databases
You've identified gaps in database monitoring and alerting, including replication lag, WAL contention, autovacuum, and table bloat
You're contributing to database performance improvements and operational documentation

By day 90:

Critical database restore tests have been completed or are progressing against an agreed recovery-testing plan, with gaps documented and corrective actions defined
Key database failure scenarios are documented through practical runbooks
Database monitoring and alerting improvements have been implemented for prioritized operational risks
You're actively contributing to database reliability, performance, and incident-prevention initiatives

By day 120:

A safer database change-management process is in place, including appropriate reviews, DDL auditing, and rollback planning
A practical PostgreSQL major-upgrade roadmap has been developed, with compatibility and migration risks assessed
The high-availability approach for the SITE database environment has been evaluated and documented
Database size and activity metrics are available to support the per-customer cost-allocation initiative

Requirements

Who You Are

You're an experienced Database Administrator who understands that managing production databases is about more than keeping services running. You know how to prevent data loss, diagnose complex performance problems, plan high-risk changes, and build systems that remain reliable under pressure.

You're comfortable working with large, business-critical databases and can balance operational stability with the need to improve architecture, automation, and scalability.

Technically, you likely:

Have 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience in production
Have experience with AWS Aurora, Amazon RDS, MySQL, and self-managed Linux databases
Understand database performance tuning, replication, high availability, and disaster recovery
Have experience managing multi-terabyte databases, upgrades, and migrations
Can automate database operations using Bash or Python

When it comes to database resilience:

You have hands-on experience with backups, recovery, replication, and failover
You can troubleshoot database incidents and minimize downtime
You follow safe change-management practices and maintain rollback plans

When it comes to database performance:

You can troubleshoot slow queries, indexing, locking, and resource utilization
You understand PostgreSQL internals and multi-tenant database challenges

What sets you apart:

You take ownership and remain calm under pressure
You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering teams
You document your work and continuously improve database reliability

Nice to Have (but not required)

Experience with multi-tenant database architectures, particularly schema-per-tenant environments with thousands of schemas
Experience managing databases larger than several terabytes with high write volumes and demanding availability requirements
Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL tooling such as Patroni, pgBackRest, or WAL-G
Experience supporting cloud migrations or moving customer workloads to in-Kingdom hosting environments
Familiarity with database observability, capacity planning, and per-customer database usage or cost allocation
Experience working in SaaS, data-platform, fintech, banking, or telecommunications environments
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools and automated database provisioning
Relevant certifications, such as EDB PostgreSQL or AWS certifications

What the hiring process will look like

Technical screen (45 min) — [DB Lead]
Technical deep-dive (60-90 min) with a practical scenario: diagnosing replication lag and WAL contention, planning a zero-downtime major upgrade — [DB Lead + SRE Team Lead]

Noon is a Saudi EdTech company. Noon Track runs inside schools: a hybrid programme that prepares students for Qudrat (قدرات) and Tahsili (تحصيلي), the national university-admission exams. Our students are 15 to 17 years old. Noon is becoming an AI-native company, department by department, and the number of schools we serve is growing. We believe every student deserves world-class teachers. And to make it happen, we’re reimagining everything about education: from cutting-edge tech to peer learning and physical spaces that spark curiosity.

Hear about our vision directly from our CEO here.
Learn more about us [here]

The role
You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience.

This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next.

Why this role
One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership.
Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters.
An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it.
A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match.

What You Will Do

Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them.
Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work.
Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering.
Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression.
Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it.
Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand.
Work directly with the product manager and engineers. Short loops, fast releases, no layers.

About you (To be successful in this role, you should have):

Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it.
A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product.
A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences
Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc.
Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods
A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment

Nice to have:
Game design or gaming industry experience.
Large-scale B2C or e-commerce experience, where A/B tests and small-metric optimisation were the daily rhythm.
Enough front-end to prototype in code with AI assistance.

Why Noon?

Real impact — your work directly affects how thousands of students learn every day.
Speed and autonomy — small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy.
AI-native culture — we don't just talk about AI, we build with it daily.
Well-funded — Series B closed, substantial recurring revenue, and accelerating.
Mission that matters — every student deserves world-class teachers. We're making it happen.

In addition to a competitive base salary, we offer:

Performance-based bonus
21 days of annual leave
Full premium Medical coverage, including Family Dependent

About B8ak
B8ak is a home services marketplace in Saudi Arabia. Customers book cleaning and maintenance through our app and web platform; thousands of vetted service professionals pick up that work and get paid through us. We've served well over 180,000 customers since launch, and the business runs on high frequency — our customers come back often, which means every friction point in the booking flow shows up in the numbers quickly.

The role
You'll own the end-to-end experience of a two-sided marketplace: the customer booking a cleaner for Thursday morning, and the technician managing their day's jobs. These are very different users with very different constraints, and the product only works when both sides do.
This is a hands-on design role with real ownership. You'll work directly with Product, Engineering, Growth and Operations, and you'll see the impact of your work in conversion and repeat-booking data within weeks.

What you'll do

Design flows, screens and components for the B8ak customer app, service-provider app, and web platform — from first sketch to production-ready specs
Own the booking funnel: service selection, scheduling, address and basket, checkout. Reducing drop-off here is the single highest-leverage design problem we have.
Optimize the booking funnel to yield better conversion page-to-page. 
Improve the first-time-to-repeat experience — onboarding, post-service follow-up, rebooking and loyalty surfaces.
Design for the provider side: job acceptance, scheduling, navigation, earnings and ratings.
Build and maintain our design system across Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR), iOS, Android and web
Run usability sessions with Saudi customers and with service professionals in the field, and turn what you learn into concrete design changes.
Partner with Growth on A/B tests — basket size, pricing presentation, lifecycle messaging — and design the variants properly rather than as afterthoughts.
Work with engineers through implementation and QA so what ships matches what was designed.
Full understanding of agile development and JIRA work environment. 

What we're looking for
4+ years designing digital products, with at least 2 years on consumer mobile apps.
A portfolio showing shipped work, with clear reasoning about the problem, the constraints and the outcome — not just polished screens
Strong command of Figma, including components, variants, auto-layout and prototyping
Real experience designing bilingual Arabic/English products with proper RTL handling. This is not a nice-to-have for us.
Comfort with data: you can read a funnel, form a hypothesis about where users are struggling, and design against it.
Working knowledge of iOS and Android platform conventions and what is realistic to build
Fluency in Arabic and English.
Strong AI fluency to expedite deliverables. 

Bonus points
Marketplace, on-demand, delivery or logistics experience.
Experience designing for field workers or blue-collar users, especially on low-end devices and patchy connections.
Familiarity with lifecycle and CRM tools (WebEngage, Braze, CleverTap).
Service design or operations-facing tooling experience.
Motion design, or front-end familiarity (HTML/CSS).

A product used every day by households across the Kingdom, with immediate and visible impact.
Design ownership of a core surface rather than ticket-taking.
A fast team where decisions get made in days, not quarters.
Competitive salary, medical insurance, and standard Saudi benefits.
On-site work with great work environment in Khobar city, we are also open to hire remotely with the right talents.

Job Title: L2 Application Support Engineer (Integration & Middleware)

Core Stack: IBM CP4I (ACE, MQ, API Connect), Spring Boot, Red Hat OpenShift.

Role Objective

The Integration Support is responsible for the health and reliability of the enterprise middleware layer. the L2 engineers to manage complex data flows between systems, ensuring that Spring Boot services and IBM CP4I components (MQ, ACE, APIC) are performant, secure, and highly available.

Strategic Technical Leadership
End-to-End Traceability: tracing transaction flows from the API Gateway (API Connect) through the Enterprise Service Bus (ACE) to the backend Microservices (Spring Boot).
Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Spearhead deep-dive investigations into middleware failures, such as message losses in MQ, synchronization errors in ACE, or JVM crashes in Spring Boot.
Platform Governance: Oversee the stability of integration components running on Red Hat OpenShift, ensuring optimal resource (CPU/Memory) allocation and pod scaling.
Security Enforcement: Manage and troubleshoot security protocols, including Mutual TLS (mTLS), OAuth2, and JWE/JWS within the integration layer.
Detailed Technical Responsibilities
IBM Cloud Pak for Integration (CP4I)
App Connect Enterprise (ACE): Troubleshoot message flows, ESQL logic errors, and adapter connectivity issues (SAP, Database, File).
IBM MQ: Manage queue managers, resolve channel retries, and investigate dead-letter queues or message persistence issues.
API Connect: Resolve issues related to API definitions, security policies, and Gateway (DataPower) latency.
Backend Microservices (Spring Boot)
Performance Tuning: Analyze JVM thread dumps and heap dumps to resolve memory leaks or high CPU utilization in microservices.
Connectivity Debugging: Troubleshoot Spring Boot integration with databases (JPA/Hibernate) and external messaging systems (JMS/Kafka).
Log Aggregation: Utilize ELK/Splunk to correlate logs across multiple microservices to identify points of failure in a distributed architecture.
Technical Skill Set
Integration Platforms: Mastery of IBM CP4I (specifically ACE, MQ, and API Connect).
Development Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Java and Spring Boot (Spring Integration, Spring Cloud).
Containerization: Expert-level proficiency in Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes.
Protocols & Standards: Expert understanding of REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, AMQP, and MQTT.
Monitoring Tools: Hands-on experience with IBM Instana, Dynatrace, or Prometheus/Grafana.
Qualifications
Experience: 5+ years in Middleware or Integration Support
Currently residing in KSA
Complex Problem Solving: Ability to debug asynchronous communication patterns and distributed transactions.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications (Preferred): IBM Cloud Pak for Integration Specialist, Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Integration Uptime: Achieving 99.99% availability for critical middleware components.
L2 Resolution Rate: Maximizing the number of integration issues resolved without escalation to L3 Engineering.
MTTR: Reducing the time taken to identify and fix failures in the message delivery pipeline.

data.description_text:
We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented, and ambitious Database Administrator Trainee to join our Data Platform team through the Tamheer Program.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, analyzing system behavior, working with data, and understanding how critical technology platforms operate behind the scenes.

As a DBA Trainee, you will gain hands-on exposure to production-scale database environments and learn how databases are designed, monitored, optimized, secured, backed up, and recovered.

Database administration requires precision and responsibility. A small configuration or query mistake can sometimes have a significant impact. Therefore, we are looking for someone who approaches tasks carefully, validates their work, asks the right questions, and remains calm when investigating technical problems.

This will be a challenging learning journey filled with technical exploration, troubleshooting, benchmarking, automation, and real-world engineering experience.

Key Responsibilities

You will work closely with experienced Database Administrators, Data Engineers, and Platform Engineers to:

Write, review, and optimize SQL queries
Analyze database performance and identify slow or inefficient queries
Support database monitoring, health checks, and capacity analysis
Assist with database backup, recovery, replication, and high-availability activities
Investigate database incidents and help identify root causes
Perform benchmarking and compare database configurations, queries, and technologies
Develop Python scripts to automate repetitive database and operational tasks
Validate data accuracy, consistency, and integrity
Prepare technical reports, performance findings, and recommendations
Support documentation of database standards, operational procedures, and best practices
Learn how database changes are safely tested before being applied to critical environments
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives across the Data Platform

Requirements

The ideal candidate should have:

Good foundational knowledge of SQL
The ability to write queries using joins, aggregations, filtering, and subqueries
Basic Python programming skills
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities
An analytical mindset and close attention to detail
The ability to compare results, benchmark solutions, and validate assumptions
A willingness to investigate problems instead of accepting results at face value
Good communication and documentation skills
A strong desire to learn database technologies and production engineering practices

Preferred Knowledge

The following experience is beneficial but not mandatory:

Familiarity with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or similar database technologies
Basic knowledge of Linux and command-line tools
Understanding of database indexes, transactions, schemas, and data types
Exposure to Git, APIs, cloud platforms, or container technologies
Experience working on academic, personal, or graduation projects involving data or automation

What You Will Learn

During the program, you will have the opportunity to learn:

How enterprise databases operate at scale
Database performance tuning and query optimization
Backup, recovery, replication, and disaster-recovery concepts
Database security and access-management practices
Monitoring, alerting, and incident investigation
Python-based database automation
Safe change-management practices for production environments
How to think and operate like a Database Reliability Engineer

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You will enjoy this role if you:

Are curious about how systems work internally
Enjoy investigating difficult technical problems
Pay attention to small details that others may overlook
Are comfortable asking questions and learning from feedback
Take ownership of your work and verify your results
See challenges as opportunities to learn and improve
Want to build a career in databases, cloud data platforms, or reliability engineering

Our Commitment to You

You will not be expected to know everything from day one.

You will receive guidance, practical experience, and opportunities to work with experienced engineers. At the same time, we will challenge you to think critically, research independently, test your ideas, and gradually take ownership of meaningful technical tasks.

This is more than a training opportunity. It is an adventure into the world of databases, where reliability, accuracy, automation, and engineering discipline come together to support systems used at scale.

data.description_text:
About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand their customers and take action across the entire customer lifecycle.

Our platform brings together products including Social Listening, OmniServe, Survey, and AI Agent, helping enterprise organizations across the region turn customer data into better experiences and measurable business outcomes.

As Lucidya continues to scale, our products are becoming more sophisticated and our customers more demanding. Design has an increasingly important role to play in making sure that complexity doesn't become the customer's problem.

Why this role matters

At this level, we're looking for someone who can move beyond simply executing designs and own problems from beginning to end.

You'll take ambiguous customer and business problems, work with Product and Engineering to understand what we're trying to achieve, explore different approaches, and drive the design through to implementation and iteration.

You'll be working on products that can involve significant amounts of data, complex workflows, AI-powered functionality, and bilingual experiences. The challenge isn't simply making these products look good — it's making them easy to understand, efficient to use, and genuinely useful for enterprise customers.

You'll have meaningful independence, but you're not expected to operate alone. You'll work alongside senior designers, Product Managers, Engineers, UX researchers, and UX writers. The strongest person in this role will know when to push their own thinking, when to ask for input, and when to challenge an assumption.

What You'll Do

Own design problems end-to-end. You'll take ownership from understanding the problem and defining the user experience through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI, handoff, implementation, and post-launch iteration. 
Turn ambiguity into clarity. Requirements won't always arrive perfectly defined. You'll work with Product, Engineering, Research, and stakeholders to understand the underlying problem and determine what we actually need to solve. 
Design for outcomes, not outputs. You'll challenge solutions that don't clearly improve the customer's experience and use research, data, and customer feedback to understand whether your designs are actually working. 
Partner closely with Product and Engineering. You'll be involved early rather than receiving requirements at the end of the process. You'll help shape what gets built and work through technical and product constraints without losing sight of the customer. 
Raise the quality of our products. You'll contribute to Lucidya's design system and help create consistency across our products while knowing when a problem requires something different. 
Bring customer evidence into design decisions. You'll conduct or support usability testing and lightweight research, using what you learn to validate assumptions rather than relying solely on personal opinion. 
Make complex products feel simple. Whether you're designing analytics, workflows, AI functionality, or customer-facing experiences, you'll look for ways to reduce cognitive load and help users get to the outcome they need faster. 
Design thoughtfully for our market. You'll account for Arabic and English experiences, RTL considerations, and the needs of enterprise customers across the region. 
Communicate your thinking clearly. You'll present work to Product, Engineering, leadership, and other stakeholders, explaining not only what you designed but why you made those decisions. 
Make the team better. You'll actively participate in critiques, give thoughtful feedback to other designers, and share what you've learned rather than keeping your knowledge within your own product area

Requirements

Who You Are

You can own a problem without needing someone to tell you every step. You know how to take an ambiguous brief, ask the right questions, break it down, and move it forward. 
You think like a product designer, not just a UI designer. You're interested in the customer, the business problem, the constraints, and the outcome — not simply whether the final interface looks polished. 
You're comfortable challenging the status quo. If you think a requirement doesn't make sense or there's a better way to solve a problem, you're willing to say so and can back your thinking with evidence. 
You know when to push and when to compromise. You can defend an important design decision while understanding that product development involves technical, commercial, and time constraints. 
You're highly collaborative. You don't throw designs over the wall to Engineering or wait for Product to tell you what to do. You work with people throughout the process. 
You're comfortable with ambiguity and change. Priorities may shift, requirements may evolve, and not every decision will be made for you. You stay focused on the outcome rather than becoming frustrated by the process. 
You're genuinely curious about users. You want to understand why customers behave the way they do and are willing to change your design when the evidence tells you that your original assumption was wrong. 
You communicate with clarity. You can explain complex design decisions to people who aren't designers and can adapt how you communicate depending on whether you're speaking with an Engineer, Product Manager, customer, or executive. 
You care about quality. You have high standards for interaction, usability, accessibility, and visual design, but you also understand when "good enough to learn" is better than spending weeks perfecting something nobody has validated. 
You have 3-5 years of product design or UX/UI experience, ideally in B2B or SaaS environments, with a portfolio demonstrating genuine end-to-end product thinking. 
You're proficient in Figma and comfortable with prototyping, design systems, and modern product design practices. 
You're a Saudi national, as this position is designated for Saudi nationals. 

Nice to Have

Experience designing data-heavy or analytics-driven B2B products. 
Experience with AI-powered products, conversational interfaces, or AI agents. 
Experience designing Arabic/English or RTL experiences. 
Familiarity with tools such as FigJam, Maze, LogRocket, or similar research and testing tools. 

What the hiring process will look like

Recruiter screening — An initial conversation about your experience, motivations, and what you're looking for next. 
Design interview — A deeper discussion with the Design team around your product thinking, design process, and approach to solving complex problems. 
Portfolio / case study presentation — You'll take us through selected projects, focusing on the problem, your role, decisions, trade-offs, collaboration, and measurable or observable outcomes. 
Team / culture interview — A conversation focused on how you work, give and receive feedback, handle disagreement, and contribute to a high-performing team. 
Final interview — Final conversation with the relevant leadership team
